A dual  Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (T2DM) is a chronic metabolic disorder characterized by insulin resistance and impaired glucose metabolism. Glimepiride, a sulfonylurea drug, is commonly used to manage blood glucose levels in T2DM patients. However, the efficacy of various active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) of Glimepiride has not been thoroughly compared.
